explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/418: 'It follows from the Goldbach conjecture that every odd number can be written as n - φ(n)'. The statement makes the needed strengthening explicit: every even n > 6 is a sum of two distinct primes. It concludes that every odd m equals n - φ(n), via n = pq with p + q = m + 1, and it is proved in Lean. Faithful.
